crossRefs.note: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.
One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.
He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in…
The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for…
The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Yahweh; but I hate him, for he…
They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

translations.web: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
translations.bsb: A mocker does not love to be reproved, nor will he consult the wise.
translations.kjv: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
translations.asv: A scoffer loveth not to be reproved; He will not go unto the wise.
